admission.justification: Spans record_state.py standing derivation, consolidation_outcomes.py index aggregation, and worktrees/review_note.py closeout notes, guarded by consolidation state tests.

applicability: Revision standing derivation, closeout review notes, and knowledge_read(view='writers') aggregation over converted memory trees.
conditions: A closed consolidation pass carrying a passed memory review handed over by a Consolidator marks written revisions, standing listed subjects, and card-only rule changes (including non-retiring card-entry deleted rows with effect != 'retire') as consolidated while unresolved and unlisted subjects keep prior state.
Closing a consolidation pass without a passed memory review appends 'Nothing was consolidated.' beside the no-pass sentence.
The writers view counts consolidationKept, consolidationCorrected, consolidationMerged, consolidationRetired, and consolidationUnresolved for the writer of the revision read.
exclusions: Retiring a rule (effect == 'retire'), which retires the record rather than marking the revision consolidated.

evidence: test_consolidation_state.py (including card-only deleted regression), test_knowledge_record_state.py, test_knowledge_writer_table.py, and sbx-e8 Evidence 8 post-closeout knowledge_read proof (6 consolidated, INV-2SYT0A99 reviewed, writers consolidationKept=6 consolidationUnresolved=1).

statement: After a closeout carrying a passed memory review handed over by a Consolidator, written revisions, standing listed subjects, and card-only rule changes (including non-retiring card-entry deleted rows) read consolidated while unresolved and unlisted subjects keep prior state; unpassed closeouts append 'Nothing was consolidated.'; writers view counts consolidationKept/Corrected/Merged/Retired/Unresolved per writer of the revision read.
title: Consolidated standing, unpassed notice, and five writer consolidation counts
